excluded_initial_experiment.reason: An initially proposed no-work report-merging change did not address the reproduced mixed LSMR/CG failure and was removed. The final source was rebuilt and the whole bounded inventory and paired measurements rerun. Manifest prose was corrected; scope inventory, seeds, observations and numerical policy were unchanged.

limits: Focused native Apple Silicon/Stata 19 development only; universal macOS slices were built and audited. No F0, SCC, Windows or release qualification, push or installed-plugin replacement.
Five alternating pairs per target/control. Each child has one cold and three warm fits; the final warm fit defines paired time. All timings and pair order are retained.

The nine sequential diagnostic cases are correctness evidence; their timings are not paired performance claims. Separate traces show operator setup and batch counts, not independent operator-application counts.

The earlier N100000 repeat failures remain separately recorded. A trace of that low-memory failure shows outcome LSMR certification followed by a regressor batch whose fresh tighter certificate fails and continues to CG; report merging then rejects mixed engines. The merge policy is unchanged.

Retained preparation is limited to eligible low-memory categorical projection. Fast/generic/sloped/output phases and warning/fallback policy beyond an active retained session remain future work; tracker M1a is only partially implemented.
The initial small N30000 constant-tail hypothesis did not reproduce the large-case error. The final manifest states this limitation; no failing result was converted to a pass.

The weighted explicit-dummy fixture uses explicit Schwarz-LSMR at tolerance 1e-10. Its original automatic and explicit-diagonal variants fail on both baseline and candidate; these failures are preserved with source/fixture/artifact identities and are not counted as passing guards. The tighter 1e-12 attempt also fails on both. Numerical comparison bounds were not relaxed.
Peak RSS was not measured. The existing broad repository-checker failures were not rerun or changed.
